selectedGeometryCarriers.targetPackage: D12.5 × 40 mm; P=5 mm; target lead diameter 0.8 mm
selectedGeometryCarriers.footprintGeometry: PTH pad centres ±2.5 mm (pitch 5.0 mm); drill 1.2 mm; copper pad Ø2.1 mm
selectedGeometryCarriers.assessment: PASS for diameter, height, pitch, and lead-hole clearance. The “D0.6” suffix is not the physical drill; measured drill is 1.2 mm. Pin numbers are generic 1/2; retain the target electrolytic polarity mapping.
selectedGeometryCarriers.evidenceFile: 水泵驱动模块/检查/载体搜索-CAP-TH_BD12.5-P5.00.json

selectedGeometryCarriers.carrierClaims: name says C8×12; library 3D model title says D8.0/H8.0/P3.50
selectedGeometryCarriers.targetPackage: D8 × 11.5 mm; P=3.5 mm; lead diameter 0.6 mm
selectedGeometryCarriers.footprintGeometry: PTH pad centres ±1.75 mm (pitch 3.50 mm); drill 1.0 mm; copper pad Ø1.6 mm
selectedGeometryCarriers.assessment: PASS for 2D lead pitch and hole fit: Nichicon specifies P=3.5 mm, lead diameter 0.6 mm, and case 8×11.5 mm; the carrier footprint has 3.50 mm hole pitch and 1.0 mm drills (0.4 mm diametral clearance). The Nichicon drawing marks the upper lead positive. The verified netlist is C_5V_OUT pin1=+5V and pin2=GND_SYS, and the device maps pin 1/2 to footprint PAD1/2, so install the positive lead into PAD1. The footprint has round pads without a +/− silk or square-pad polarity cue. Carrier 3D H8.0 mm differs from target H11.5 mm by 3.5 mm; do not use this carrier model as target clearance evidence. The procurement MPN remains Nichicon; the listed carrier is CAD geometry only.
selectedGeometryCarriers.evidenceFile: 水泵驱动模块/检查/载体搜索-CAP-TH_BD8.0-P3.50.json

dimensionalVerification.targetDimensions: Nichicon UHE1C331MPD: case Ø8×11.5 mm; lead pitch P=3.5 mm; lead diameter Ø0.6 mm.
dimensionalVerification.carrierGeometry: Footprint hole centres are 3.50 mm apart; drill diameter=1.0 mm; copper pad diameter=1.6 mm. Both pads are round; footprint has no +/− silk or square-pad polarity marker.
dimensionalVerification.polarityEvidence: Nichicon datasheet drawing marks the upper lead positive. Verified schematic netlist: C_5V_OUT pin1=+5V and pin2=GND_SYS; device pin numbering maps 1→PAD1 and 2→PAD2. Orient the component with its positive lead in PAD1; this polarity is not visually encoded by the footprint artwork.
dimensionalVerification.heightLimitation: Carrier 3D model title says H8.0 mm versus target H11.5 mm (3.5 mm shorter); carrier 3D data is not valid target clearance evidence.
dimensionalVerification.source: Nichicon UHE datasheet, p.1 package/polarity drawing and p.3 exact part row; https://www.nichicon.com/en-us/datasheet/5715/; net evidence: 水泵驱动模块/检查/网表逐脚核对.json

selectedGeometryCarriers.carrierClaims: Panasonic D10×10.2 mm; footprint land centres x=±4.5 mm, pad 4.5×1.65 mm
selectedGeometryCarriers.targetPackage: AiSHi GB0 D10 × 10.5 mm; catalogue table gives P=4.5 mm, W=0.7–1.1 mm
selectedGeometryCarriers.footprintGeometry: SMD land centres ±4.5 mm (centre distance 9.0 mm); each land 4.5×1.65 mm
selectedGeometryCarriers.assessment: PASS for the target drawing’s 2D diameter and terminal-gap dimensions. AiSHi GB0 drawing P=4.5 mm is the clear gap between the two facing terminal inner edges, not terminal centre pitch: the EEEF carrier has 9.0 mm land-centre spacing and 4.5 mm land length, giving a 4.5 mm inner-edge gap. D=10 mm matches. This does not establish an AiSHi-recommended PCB land pattern: carrier land width is 1.65 mm versus target terminal width 0.7–1.1 mm, and target body height 10.5 mm differs from carrier 10.2 mm by 0.3 mm. Current netlist is pin1=BUS_M and pin2=GND_SYS; physical positive-pad orientation remains to be checked against the selected carrier symbol/pad orientation before PCB release. Procurement MPN remains AiSHi; EEEFK2A330P is only the CAD geometry carrier.
selectedGeometryCarriers.evidenceFile: 水泵驱动模块/检查/载体搜索-EEEFK2A330P.json

dimensionalVerification.targetDrawingInterpretation: AiSHi GB0 drawing P=4.5 mm spans the gap between the facing inner edges of the two terminals; it is not terminal centre-to-centre pitch.
dimensionalVerification.targetDimensions: D=10.0 mm; body height=10.5 mm; terminal inner-edge gap P=4.5 mm; terminal width W=0.7–1.1 mm.
dimensionalVerification.carrierCalculation: EEEFK2A330P land centres x=±4.5 mm -> centre spacing 9.0 mm; each land length=4.5 mm -> facing inner-edge gap=9.0−4.5=4.5 mm.
dimensionalVerification.comparison: Nominal body diameter and terminal inner-edge gap match. Carrier height is 10.2 mm (0.3 mm below target); land width is 1.65 mm, and no AiSHi PCB land-pattern recommendation was identified in the cited catalogue.
dimensionalVerification.polarity: Target catalogue drawing indicates polarity, while the current netlist assigns C_5V_IN pin1=BUS_M and pin2=GND_SYS. Confirm carrier symbol/pad orientation against the target positive terminal before fabricating a PCB; this dimension check does not establish that orientation.
dimensionalVerification.source: AiSHi Full Catalog, printed pp.72–73: GB0 package drawing/dimensions and exact EMK1KM330GB0D00T row; https://aishi.com/files/3_AiSHi_Full_Catalog.pdf

nativeNetLabelsAndGround.important: 电气网络名可由带 net 属性的 SCH_PrimitiveWire.create(line, net) 命名导线建立ENET；也可用原生Netport/NetFlag或器件 Global Net Name 属性。当前水泵原理图使用命名导线，逐脚网表已通过。单纯 SCH_PrimitiveText 仅为文字，不建立网络连接。

namedWire.behavior: A wire created with its net attribute forms an ENET connection and can show the native wire name at the remote end.
namedWire.currentProjectEvidence: The final pump schematic uses named wires and the read-only pin/net check reports 197/197 pin/net + NC assignments matched; redundant Netport components were removed.
namedWire.distinction: SCH_PrimitiveText is annotation only and does not create an electrical connection.

limitations: CAD carrier identity is separate from the procurement MPN; carrier data must not overwrite BOM procurement identity.

C_5V_IN has a verified 2D diameter and terminal inner-gap match, but no AiSHi PCB land-pattern recommendation was identified; its carrier land width/body height and positive-pad orientation still require board-level review.

C_5V_OUT has verified 2D pitch/hole fit. Its carrier 3D model H8.0 mm differs from target H11.5 mm, and the footprint has no polarity marking; put the Nichicon positive lead into PAD1 (net +5V) and do not use the carrier model for clearance.

L_5V has exact official device MPN but library footprint title says SWPA8040S while target is SWPA8065S101MT; compare detailed pad geometry against Sunlord land-pattern drawing before considering the footprint mechanically verified.
WeAct 2×12 interface connector is exact 2×12/2.54 mm library device; core-board version, mating gender, row spacing and pin-1 orientation need the WeAct Normal mechanical drawing.
This is asset and schematic-library reuse evidence only; it is not PCB or physical acceptance.
